name: Mercury
description: The smallest planet and the closest planet to the Sun.

name: Venus
description: A rocky planet with a very dense, hot atmosphere.

name: Earth
description: Our home planet, with liquid water on its surface.

name: Moon
description: Earth's natural satellite; distance values here are from Earth, not the Sun.

name: Mars
description: A rocky world with seasons and evidence of ancient liquid water.

name: Jupiter
description: The largest planet in the Solar System; its moon count can change as new moons are confirmed.

name: Saturn
description: A gas giant best known for its extensive ring system.

name: Uranus
description: An ice giant that rotates with an extreme axial tilt.

name: Neptune
description: A distant ice giant with powerful winds.

name: Pluto
description: A dwarf planet in the Kuiper Belt, beyond Neptune.
